title: Seahawks QB Jalen Milroe lauds Ty Simpson for 'trusting the process'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Seahawks QB Jalen Milroe lauds Ty Simpson for 'trusting the process'
sources.description: Jalen Milroe worked with Ty Simpson across three seasons at Alabama. He came away impressed by the 2026 NFL Draft prospect's progress and patience.
